title: NASA seeks commercial proposals to boost Hubble's orbit
excerpt: NASA is taking proposals from the commercial space industry to help boost the Hubble Space Telescope's orbit and prevent its eventual demise.
body_html:
NASA is looking to the commercial space industry for help in saving the Hubble Space Telescope. Due to the gradual pull of gravity, the telescope's orbit is slowly drawing closer to Earth. While Hubble is not in immediate danger of burning up in the atmosphere, its operational timeline is projected to end in the early to mid-2030s unless its orbit is raised.

To address this challenge, the space agency is actively gathering proposals from commercial space companies. Boosting the telescope's altitude could extend its lifespan and allow it to continue operations beyond its currently projected expiration.
